Evidence: lines 597‑609 in endocrine.py join the target lines into `block`, replace `old_frag` with `new_frag`, then assign the resulting `new_block` as a single‑element list to the slice `lines[start_line:end_line + 1]`. This destroys the original line‑boundary structure because `new_block` may contain newlines but is stored as one list element.  
FOLLOW: This bug only affects fixes that use line‑range replacement patterns (e.g., “Lines 10‑20: old → new”). The resulting patched source will have the wrong number of lines, causing syntax errors when the patched file is read by tools (pyright, mypy, etc.), leading to spurious tool‑issue counts and incorrect fix verdicts (SAFE/HARMFUL/NEUTRAL).
